item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong 2024 evidence of Putin creating durable, formal conflict-of-interest barriers around family, personal wealth, or loyalist business holdings. The positive side is thin and mostly indirect: a technocratic appointment, a narrow anti-corruption probe, and deference to the central bank. None of those amount to a clear pattern of separating private/loyalist interests from state power. The negative side is much stronger: secrecy expansion, patronage, and corruption in state contracting.","evidence":[{"title":"Putin taps civilian economist to run defence","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-05-13","url":"https://theprint.in/world/putin-taps-civilian-economist-to-run-defence/2081878/","summary":"Putin replaced long-time ally Sergei Shoigu with economist Andrei Belousov, which is a real technocratic move and a weak sign of preference for managerial competence over pure loyalty in a major state portfolio. But the same report says Shoigu was moved to the Security Council, so the core security circle remained intact.","question_ids":["7B.3","7B.2"]},{"title":"Russian central bank keeps rates on hold after Putin’s call for balance","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-12-20","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-central-bank-keeps-rates-on-hold-after-putins-call-for-balance-3784135","summary":"Putin publicly backed the central bank’s tight policy rather than overruling it, which is weak evidence that he sometimes accepts expert monetary judgment instead of forcing a politically convenient line. This is limited support, not a structural conflict-of-interest firewall.","question_ids":["7B.3","7B.2"]},{"title":"Two more Russian officials arrested in widening military corruption probe","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-05-23","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/two-more-russian-officials-arrested-in-widening-military-corruption-probe-3454644","summary":"Russia arrested additional defense officials in a bribery probe tied to a spending-heavy sector, which shows some internal anti-corruption enforcement around state contracts. It is evidence of correction inside the system, but not evidence that Putin built strong separation from patronage networks.","question_ids":["7B.3","7B.2"]},{"title":"Putin lets economically significant entities limit information disclosures","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-29","url":"https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/putin-lets-economically-significant-entities-limit-information-disclosures-3315001","summary":"Putin widened secrecy privileges so major firms could stop publicly disclosing information, reducing outside scrutiny of powerful entities. That makes insider privilege easier to hide and weakens separation between state power and private or loyalist interests.","question_ids":["7B.3","7B.2"]},{"title":"Russia 2024 Freedom in the World","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House describes a system where corruption is pervasive, elites get contracts and protection for loyalty, state and business are entangled, and officials can use office to accumulate property and influence outcomes. This is strong background evidence against clean separation of state decisions from personal and patronage interests.","question_ids":["7B.3"]},{"title":"Russia 2024 Nations in Transit","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/nations-transit/2024","summary":"Freedom House says the regime distributes economic assets to allies in exchange for loyalty and that disclosure and accountability remain weak. That directly supports a patronage model rather than one that separates state decisions from insider benefit.","question_ids":["7B.3"]},{"title":"Kremlin law on social-media user data and biometric controls","publisher":"President of Russia","date":"2024-08-08","url":"https://en.special.kremlin.ru/acts/news/74828","summary":"The law increased state control over user data and identity, illustrating how regulatory power is used to expand surveillance and administrative leverage. It does not show separation from political interest; it shows continued concentration of coercive control.","question_ids":["7B.3","7B.2"]}]}
